draftTests.agentObservation: Structured-data hours: none. Visible hours: ['100% satisfaction guarantee in writing', 'Vidal the serviceman was awesome. He was very thorough with explaining all the details associated with what was wrong with my A/C. Very professional, very personable, super nice and took care of the problem. He sold us an annual maintenance program which I thought was very reasonable and will definitely save us some money in the long run. Overall the quality of professionalism with all the staff was “5” Star, we couldn’t have been more pleased with the service. Thank you Majestic AC.', 'A friend said I should call Majestic AC for HVAC service. When my A/C stopped cooling three days later, I called….and they apologized profusely for not being able to get here the same day. The next day, the technician fixed the issue in about 20 minutes (in the rain). The best part of Majestic Air is a tie between professional and courteous customer service and their very reasonable pricing. I’m passing on the “highly recommend” rating to y’all, just as my friend did for me.', 'Contacted Majestic on Sunday for home AC repair of unit that stopped working. They were able to put on the schedule the next day. Service techs were very polite and knowledgeable. Issue repaired within 30 minutes of their arrival. We are long time users of their services and have never had a bad experience.', 'Our AC stopped working on Friday night. I called Majestic on Saturday morning and had a technician, Jacob, within a couple hours diagnosing my problem at a reasonable labor rate. It’s 17 years old. Jacob explained the situation and why we need a new unit. He was very knowledgeable. Bryan, a sales/install rep, was available and took the time to come out and go over options. He explained everything very clearly and we got our replacement install scheduled. We have been doing business with Majestic since we bought our house in 2008, and I would highly recommend them.', "Majestic represents everything a company should strive to be; Professional, caring, and precise. AC went out Fri evening, Easter weekend. We put in our request Sat afternoon and David replied to us late Sat. He made arrangements to visit Sunday mid-day after service. He spent 2 hours with us on Easter Sunday to make sure we understood exactly what we were purchasing. We agreed on the new product and terms and the following Tuesday morning Majestic's crew was at out house installing the new unit. Wade and his crew came in with the same approach as David, professional and courteous. Walked us through the entire system, how it works, what to expect, etc. and finished the job in about 6 hours, leaving our house spotless. David circled back around with us 2 days after the install to walk the house, check temps and thermostat settings, spent another hour talking about everything and anything other than AC. They are sending another tech this week to triple check the work and settings just to make sure nothing was missed. Majestic, David and Wade specifically, created a life long customer because they simply did what most people expect. Hats off to you gents! Thank you for doing the simple things! Sincerely, The Spradlings.", 'AC stopped cooling Saturday night. I called Majestic Air Sunday morning around 9am. They had someone out to my house by 2pm.
